title: Track38 Voyager Space Memory Map V1 DISCOVER visual/function donor
productJob: DISCOVER visual/spatial donor only; canonical public Tree/Memory authority, search/discovery semantics and read-only public-tree navigation remain owned by /v4/community.
summary: Issue #477 re-reviews Track38 against current-main Discover. Direct standalone adoption is rejected because the source is a canvas prototype over synthetic celebrity/video fixtures, direct YouTube thumbnail/embed runtime and continuous auto-orbit without a reduced-motion or keyboard-node contract. Current /v4/community already owns public discovery and V4PublicTree already renders actual public-memory relationships. The bounded Design Lab donor proof therefore consumes the existing public community APIs and reuses only Track38's cosmic spatial field, node constellation, parent-child lines, selected-memory inspector and map-layout grammar.

provenance.rightsStatus: repository snapshot provenance pinned; external YouTube fixture/runtime usage is source-reference-only and is not copied into the donor implementation

trulyNewPrimitive: none — bounded DISCOVER presentation donor over existing /v4/community public Tree/Memory authority
sourceDefects: source person/video/emotion fixtures are synthetic and cannot become canonical public discovery truth
source generates thumbnails from i.ytimg.com and embeds youtube.com directly from fixture video ids
source runs requestAnimationFrame continuously and defaults auto orbit on without a prefers-reduced-motion contract
source canvas nodes are not keyboard focus targets; keyboard handling is limited to Escape
source touch-action:none and wheel preventDefault make the canvas own mobile/wheel interaction too aggressively for canonical Discover
nativeRemediations: consume only existing /api/community/trees and /api/community/memories public data; do not add schema/API/Auth state
render public memories as native DOM buttons with actual parentId edges instead of synthetic graph fixtures
provide native search, emotion filters, layout, zoom, pan and reset controls that are keyboard/touch reachable
remove direct YouTube iframe/thumbnail dependencies from the bounded donor proof
honor prefers-reduced-motion and do not auto-orbit or continuously animate the map
sourceOnlyValues: synthetic celebrity names and 18 hard-coded YouTube video ids
generated 24 emotion fragments per source video
